name: gh-writer
description: Plan and write a novel with GitHub: local-first writing app, story bible and diagrams.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/editor/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:template: node scripts/build-validator.ts templates/novel/.github/gh-writer/validate.mjs && node scripts/build-validator.ts --snapshots templates/novel/.github/gh-writer/snapshots.mjs && node scripts/build-validator.ts --compile templates/novel/.github/gh-writer/compile.mjs && node templates/novel/.github/gh-writer/snapshots.mjs templates/novel && node templates/novel/.github/gh-writer/snapshots.mjs examples/sample-novel
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e -w @gh-writer/editor && npm run test:e2e -w @gh-writer/web
